sections.title: Right now
lines: Pregame build, kickoff 3:25pm CT. Sold 138, 993 resting. Worst line -$42 (goal -$75).

sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: Lagging (75+ behind the leader): LAR by 1-6, LAR by 7-14, LAR by 15+, LV by 1-6, LV by 15+.
LAR by 15+: 66 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
LV by 15+: 66 behind. No crowd trade data yet.
A price step needs 10 min with no fill and the crowd paying less.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: A side gets a new batch when its resting drops under 25% of launch.
Gate open: worst line -$42 is better than -$100.

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Backstop off. It trips if the worst line falls under -$150.
Paid balancing starts 2:40pm CT: worst line to -$75 by 3:15pm CT, up to $50.
At 2:55pm CT, if worst line is -$75 or better, paid balancing stops.
Kickoff 3:25pm CT: the in-game engine takes over.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Mostly yes: price steps, new batches and paid balancing run by rule. It will not reprice for line moves or news.
